title: EtaleResolutionSectionCanonicalTransfer
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be a scheme morphism, $G$ an abelian etale sheaf on $X$, $I$ an injective resolution of $G$, and $J$ an injective resolution of $g^{-1}G$. Suppose $\alpha:I\to g_*J$ is a chain map with $I.\iota^0\alpha^0=\eta_{g,G}g_*(J.\iota^0)$. Let $c_X,c_Y$ be normalized comparisons for these two resolutions [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. Then they carry the global section transfer of $\alpha$ to $\operatorname{cohomologyMap}(g)$ and the open section transfer over each $W\subseteq X$ to $\operatorname{openCohomologyPullback}(g,W)$, with its prescribed coefficient transport [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-transfer], [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Only these two transfer identities are asserted; no comparisons are constructed and no restriction identities are asserted.
